about: K192 (the owner's pick, 2026-11-20): rule cues. When a message names one of these topics, the prompt hook puts the rule's own words in front of the session, quoted word for word from the source file named, so a cue never says more or less than its rule. A test holds each quote to its source. Recall then partly measures the cue, so behaviour scenarios 4, 7, 9, 10 and 13 check the same rules by acts, and the paired run records a recall arm with the cues off (KIT_RULE_CUES=off) beside the gate's.
